$comment: UNTESTED: written on a machine with no vcpkg and no network. What this tree's own build needs from vcpkg when configured with a vcpkg toolchain and -DIMTYPESET_USE_IMGUI_PACKAGE=ON: Dear ImGui as a package (imgui::imgui). It is a manifest, not a port; the port sketch is ports/imtypeset. See docs/distribution.md.
